title: IMB 6002 (MB6002B)
subtitle: Automatic Button Feeder Attachment

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The IMB 6002 (model MB6002B) is an automatic cylinder-driven button feeding attachment designed to deliver buttons one-by-one to the workstation of a compatible lockstitch button-sewing machine. It eliminates the manual step of placing each button under the needle, allowing a single operator to run high-volume button-sewing at consistent cycle times.
applications: Automatic button feeding on shirt placket, cuff, and collar button-sewing workstations
High-volume button attachment lines that previously required manual placement
Retrofit to existing JUKI 1900-series and Brother 438-series button-sewing heads
Use with compatible Chinese-brand direct-drive button-sewing heads
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (shirts, blouses, trousers, workwear), mass-production apparel assembly lines

overviewDescription: The IMB 6002 (MB6002B) is an automatic cylinder-driven button feeder. Buttons are loaded into a hopper and individually picked up by a rotating cylinder mechanism, which transfers them to the sewing workstation in a consistent orientation. The unit has both manual-feed and auto-feed modes (switchable) and is rated at approximately 99.8% feeding stability. It is marketed as an attachment unit rather than a standalone stitching machine — it must be paired with a compatible button-sewing head.

technicalSpecs.value: JUKI 1900 series, Brother 438 series, and other Chinese-brand button-sewing heads
Shirt placket, cuff, collar button attaching
